description: HTML source code for a database viewer web interface, including CSS styles and JavaScript for data fetching and UI interactions

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and UI state

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML table from data array

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell with special handling for large or object data

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data
